_comment: M4: the jigsaw DISTRICT's generator-side buildings. Run with: java -cp tools/spike/out CityStructureGen --pieces-only --foundation 5 tools/district-layout.json  -  it writes ONE structure NBT per building into src/main/resources/data/tarkovscav/structures/buildings/ and never touches the four shipped city templates. The look follows the M1 survey of the user's own hand-built district: light-grey / brown concrete walls, a terracotta wainscot on the ground floor, a torch, a bed, more cover per floor, a real door, and a 5-block footing.
name: gen_district
